name: Rival AXS crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed non-power crankset reference: 172.5 mm arms, 48/35T chainrings, DUB spindle; excludes bottom bracket. The 2025 sheet separately identifies the power-meter options and bottom bracket. No conversion to an estimated 170 mm weight is made.
